criteria.requirement: Add webcolors.rgba with immutable validated RGBA(red,green,blue,alpha=255), exact 4/8-digit hex_to_rgba, lossless 8-digit rgba_to_hex, rgb_to_rgba and opaque-only rgba_to_rgb. All channels are integer bytes 0..255 (bool/float rejected); zero-alpha hidden RGB is retained. Do not alter legacy RGB or HTML simple-color functions to accept/drop alpha. Reject malformed lengths, suffixes and whitespace; do not clamp silently or use a white background implicitly. Provide complete source implementation, public roundtrip/error tests and Chinese compatibility documentation.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
